findings.reason: The original standalone tiles show the full truth table and verification but no wire picture. A four-wire circuit materially clarifies which bits control each gate, the upward work-to-target copy, and reuse of the same Toffoli to restore clean work. This is a warranted explanatory addition under the expanded diagram scope; the original proof is already complete.
findings.action: Added one native TikZ circuit in final Remarks, with left-to-right chronology, input/output labels, control/target legend and relation to Verification Steps 1.1–2.1.

correction: Appended only final Remarks containing the four-wire compute-copy-uncompute illustration and explanation. All original bytes remain an unchanged prefix; frontmatter including status: published is byte-identical.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Four ordered qubit wires (a,b,y,w), with bits a,b,y arbitrary and input w=0; each gate embeds as a unitary from the four-qubit register to itself.
diagram_math_checks.check: The restricted clean-work input subspace maps |a,b,y,0> to |a,b,y xor ab,0>. Output wire order equals input wire order. This is the Example display and Verification Steps 1.1–3.1.

diagram_math_checks.objects: First gate: Toffoli controls a,b, target w.
diagram_math_checks.check: Only a and b carry filled dots; the target is on w, while its crossing of y has no dot. By F1 and def-qc-toffoli-and-fredkin, (a,b,y,0) becomes (a,b,y,ab), as Verification Step 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Middle gate: CNOT control w, target y.
diagram_math_checks.check: The bottom filled dot is w, circled plus is y. By F4 and def-qc-cnot-and-control-target-order, (a,b,y,ab) becomes (a,b,y xor ab,ab); this does not change w. No gate acts on a or b in the middle column.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Last gate: Toffoli controls a,b, target w.
diagram_math_checks.check: The same two controls toggle w by ab once more, producing ab xor ab=0 while preserving y xor ab. Therefore work follows 0,ab,ab,0, consistent with F2, def-qc-clean-and-dirty-ancillas and Verification Step 2.1.

Read left to right: Toffoli(a,b;w), CNOT(w;y), Toffoli(a,b;w). This agrees with F5/def-qc-circuit-denotational-semantics (last gate multiplies on the left). The unchanged eight-row table and Verification Steps 1.1–3.1 establish the map on the clean-work subspace and its linear extension without using the picture.
